CamelCaseMap._convert_key:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Converts string keys to camel case via _to_camel_case and returns non-string keys unchanged." _convert_key]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> key </REF>: object "The key to convert; if it is a string or string subclass, it is converted to camel case, otherwise it is returned unchanged."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: object "The camel-case-converted string if key is a string or string subclass, otherwise the original key."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether key is an instance of str, including str subclasses. RESULT is_str]
            [COMMAND If is_str is true, immediately call self._to_camel_case(key) and return the converted string. RESULT converted_key]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: is_str is false, meaning key is not a string or string subclass]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return key unchanged. RESULT original_key]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
CamelCaseMap._to_camel_case:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Converts an underscore-separated string to camelCase by retaining the segment before the first underscore and title-casing and concatenating all remaining segments." _to_camel_case]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> key </REF>: string "The underscore-separated string to convert to camelCase."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "The converted camelCase string."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Split the input string key by the underscore delimiter with split('_') and assign the resulting list of substrings to parts. Consecutive, leading, and trailing underscores are preserved as empty-string elements. RESULT parts]
            [COMMAND Set initial_segment to parts[0], which is the text before the first underscore, or an empty string if key starts with an underscore. RESULT initial_segment]
            [COMMAND Within a generator expression over parts[1:], convert each remaining substring to title case with title(), then join all converted substrings with an empty separator to produce tail_segment. If there are no remaining substrings, tail_segment is an empty string. RESULT tail_segment]
            [COMMAND Concatenate initial_segment and tail_segment to form final_result. RESULT final_result]
            [COMMAND Return final_result. RESULT final_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
